FFmpeg — LGPL static build for Windows x64 (decode-only)
========================================================
Used by: HeardRight + ScrapeRight (decode arbitrary audio -> 16 kHz mono for
transcription). Windows twin of the macOS-arm64 LGPL build (same FFmpeg 7.1.5,
same intent, same decode-only posture).

Version:        FFmpeg 7.1.5 (release)
Upstream:       https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.5.tar.xz
Source SHA-256: de668509caf9e35e3cd162473441fdb29538c6d96ed080292b3cf9e6fc5d558f
Built:          2026-07-05
Toolchain:      MSYS2 MINGW64 shell — gcc 16.1.0 (x86_64-w64-mingw32), nasm 2.16.03
Binary:         ffmpeg-win-x64.exe
Binary SHA-256: ded75c0edf344b9eed5876cd6cc469b7366b00c4dd0f25b3965062965c33990d
Size:           16.4 MB  (vs ~108 MB for BtbN's full LGPL build)

LICENSE: LGPL version 2.1 or later  (confirmed by configure output)
  - NO --enable-gpl, NO --enable-nonfree.
  - NO libx264 / libx265 / libfdk-aac (GPL/nonfree encoders) — not built.
  - Decode-only: FFmpeg's built-in native decoders (H.264/HEVC/AV1/VP9/AAC/
    Opus/MP3/FLAC) need no external libraries. We never encode.

CONFIGURE FLAGS (exact, as built):
  ./configure \
    --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-autodetect \
    --enable-static --disable-shared \
    --disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --enable-small \
    --arch=x86_64 --target-os=mingw32 \
    --extra-ldflags="-static -static-libgcc"
  make -j$(nproc)

VERIFICATION (all passed 2026-07-05):
  [1] -version configuration has no --enable-gpl / --enable-nonfree
      ("License: LGPL version 2.1 or later" at configure time)
  [2] objdump -p ffmpeg-win-x64.exe imports ONLY Windows system DLLs:
      bcrypt, gdi32, kernel32, msvcrt, ole32, oleaut32, shell32, shlwapi,
      user32, avicap32, ws2_32
      -> NO libwinpthread-1.dll, NO libgcc_s, NO msys-2.0.dll (fully static)
  [3] decode opus   -> 16000 Hz mono pcm_s16le : OK
      decode aac/m4a -> 16000 Hz mono pcm_s16le : OK

WIRING:
  ScrapeRight (package.ps1): set env FFMPEG_WIN_X64_SRC to this file before
    building, or default the script's ffmpeg source to it. Replaces the prior
    GPL imageio-ffmpeg binary and removes the Find-ImageioFfmpeg dependency.
  HeardRight: point the Windows ffmpeg staging override at this file (the
    Windows counterpart of HR_FFMPEG_DARWIN_SRC).

REPRODUCE:
  1. Install MSYS2 (https://www.msys2.org/), open the MINGW64 shell.
  2. pacman -S --needed mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc make nasm yasm diffutils pkgconf
  3. curl -fsSLO https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.5.tar.xz && tar xf ffmpeg-7.1.tar.xz && cd ffmpeg-7.1
  4. Run the configure + make above. Configure tail must say:
       License: LGPL version 2.1 or later

NOTE: Code signing (Azure Trusted Signing) is a separate step — this is the
clean, unsigned LGPL binary.
